name: TruePlanet
author: Xm0x
description: Seeded spherical planets with a rotatable globe, optional flat map and native floating controls. Responsive planet generation and real loading stages; cached gameplay atlas beside Achievements and selected/current-tile Reset view. Nations, provinces, settlements and orange roads share persistent geographic tiles, including wilderness. Standard/Detailed resolution and fixed local map size. Single-scene travel saves native snapshots and carries campaign currencies/skill progression; local worlds remain separate. Legacy province saves remain readable. Requires RuinarchModLoader 0.9.0. No Travel Portal structures, offscreen simulation or seamless streaming.
